about: The bodyIds a document handed over whole (MCP doc_set, a plugin's doc_set) is built with. A missing or malformed map becomes an empty one, so a join keeps its target's id as it does in any new document; a map that is there is kept as it is, partial or not. Opening a file does not do this: a file without the map was saved before it existed. Replayed by crates/fundacad-core/tests/shared_vectors.rs and tests/document/bodyIds.test.ts.

cases.name: no map is numbered as a new document
a partial map is kept as it is
